label: On the Rooftop, A Private Supplementary Lesson for Two

lines.text: Amy stops walking and turns around, as if sensing my presence.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: How long are you going to keep following me?
Sorry. If I'm bothering you.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: No, it's fine.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: But why are you following me?
Um...
Because I've gotten pretty close to my classmates?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Haha, what is that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I heard you're a famous commander, and you were a teacher before that.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I thought you were kind of intimidating,

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: but now I feel pretty comfortable around you.
Can we talk for a bit?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: You want to convince me to join the festival, don't you?
That's part of it, but...
I also want to hear your story. As a friend.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I've been feeling frustrated, in more ways than one.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Do you know what kind of Nikkes come to this school?
I'm not sure, is there some kind of selection criteria?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Of all the Nikkes manufactured by Missilis, there are those who are impressive but not quite outstanding.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: The ones that show the potential for growth are sent to the M.M.R Vocational School.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: They have to get passing grades on all of their exams,

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: which is why most fail to graduate.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Honestly, I was a nervous wreck before I even got here,

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: because I had to give a speech. Apparently, my most recent grades were higher than anyone else's.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Still, I kept worrying that I wasn't enough, that I wouldn't be able to handle life here.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: it's been very different from what I imagined.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: We all laugh a lot, and chat, and joke around...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: We hang out after school together and get good food...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: We get sleepy in class, and hate when the teachers give us homework...
Pretty ordinary, right?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yeah, it's been really normal.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: So much so that I think I'd forgotten...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: what kind of place this school really is.
Isn't that a good thing? To feel less stressed?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: But we're Nikkes first and foremost, not students.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: The moment the festival was brought up, it suddenly hit me.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Is this really the time for me to be having fun?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm not even a real student...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I am overthinking things, right? Haha...
Not at all. Anyone would feel this way given the circumstances.
I begin to overthinking things as well...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I think I understand Miss Privaty's intentions.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: She wants to give everyone some room to breathe.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I don't know the full story since I just transferred here, but the others must have been exhausted for a long time.
Yeah...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: But I don't think I'm fully ready yet.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Could you talk to her for me?
Me?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I think you can explain it better than I can.
Sure. Okay.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Thank you for listening, and for being a friend.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'm gonna head back to the dormitory.
Amy smiles brightly, then turns and walks out of the school.
I should go find Privaty.
But she's nowhere to be seen in the classroom, the teachers' office, or the nurse's office.
Where is she...?
At that moment...
I recall something that she said to me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Next time, I'll take you to a quiet place that I know.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I think you'll like it.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's nice and spacious,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: and there's not a single soul there.
I look up at the stairs I've never gone up before.
Could it be...
*Step, step*
I ascend the stairs as quickly as I can,
reaching the second floor, then the third.
At the top of the last flight of stairs, a door stands slightly ajar.
*Creeeak*
As I open the door, the glare from the sunset blinds me.
*Whoooosh*
A wide-open rooftop.
A gentle breeze blowing through.
And...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I was just thinking about you.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You really came.
Miss Privaty.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: How did you know I was here?
You mentioned this place last time.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're quite an attentive student.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Very commendable.
Privaty laughs lightly and pats my head.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You followed Amy right after class ended.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Did you talk with her?
Yes.
I tell Privaty about the conversation I had with Amy.
How she feels about this school,
and even the anxiety she's been feeling.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I figured there might be students who would oppose it or feel pressured.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Turns out I was right.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Thank you for talking with Amy.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: She sees you as a classmate and a friend, so she feels comfortable talking to you.
Miss Privaty...
I cautiously reach out toward Privaty, who seems a little downcast...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: However!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Honestly, it feels a little unfair.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: She didn't even give the festival a chance, choosing instead to be dismissive of it.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I guess that means...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll just have to turn this into the perfect festival.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I've given it a lot of thought.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: This is not an ordinary school,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: and because of that, the actions teachers take are extremely important.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Yes, we were originally sent here to improve the school's reputation,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: but I really do want to give the students a festival that they can enjoy.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I even managed to convince the admin office to replace one midterm with the festival and its preparations.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Not just for Amy, but for everyone.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And I'll make sure everyone who visits the school has the best time possible.
Watching Privaty speak so confidently without second-guessing herself...
I can't help but burst out laughing.
Hahaha!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: What's so funny?
Nothing. It's nothing at all. I just realized how silly it was of me to worry.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I was only able to handle all this so well...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: because of you, {AccountData.NickName}.
Sorry?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: At first...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I wanted to give everyone a once-in-a-lifetime school experience.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I decided I had to create a fun festival.
Privaty takes one step closer.
Close enough that her hair brushes against me when the wind blows.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And if everyone's having fun, then surely you'd have fun too.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That was all I wanted...
Privaty takes another step closer.
Close enough that if I blew gently, her bangs would sway.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But as time goes by, I feel increasingly jealous... and greedy...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I can't control my feelings anymore.
Privaty takes yet another step closer.
Close enough that we can feel each other's breath.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: So, since we've come this far,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I find myself wanting to be the focal point of your school experience.
Privaty lifts her head and looks into my eyes.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I was thinking we could do something only a teacher and student can do,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: something students can't do amongst themselves...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... A one-on-one lesson.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what do you think...?
Privaty lightly grips my collar.
The sight of her is so adorable,
I reach out and pull her toward me.
What type of lesson?
Where are we on the curriculum?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I haven't thought that far yet.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Your mind's in the gutter, isn't it?!
You said it was a one-on-one lesson, so I was just asking.
I think it's you who has your mind in the gutter.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: H-hey!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You're the one who made it weird!
As I hold Privaty in my arms, she playfully pounds at my chest.
Hehe, enough fooling around.
*Mwah*
A jolt like lightning shoots through my neck, and goosebumps ripples across my skin.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Today's lesson...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ends here.
Good grief...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: No need to be impatient.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: The sun hasn't even set yet.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: There's still plenty of time for review.
We stay together on the rooftop until the sun sets.
For the next few days, I wear a turtleneck, even though it's not remotely cold out.
And it's all thanks to my amazing teacher.
A few days later,
The M.M.R. Vocational School officially begins preparing for the festival.
2X2 LOVE: Privaty - True Ending (1)
